p: Send a state and typed questions to POST /v1/decisions with model: "kai" . Kai answers each question with a probability for every answer it allows, and writes no text.
Name each question; its answer comes back under the same name.
Every response also carries id, model, usage (output_tokens is 0), routing (the checkpoint that answered: kai-1.3 for the model id kai), state_hash and latency_ms.

h2: Change the URL, the key and the model

p: Kai takes the request body Jev takes. The same endpoint also serves typesafe/jev-1.13 with a Hanzo key, at Jev’s price.
